add: /* Resistance port: solver-guard. r104 is the item count of the loop at
* 0x12F84, whose counter is a 16-bit halfword: a count above 0xFFFF can
* never be reached and the job spins forever (York freeze). Only a few
* hundred items fit in local store, so a count above 4096 is corrupt
* input: process nothing instead. SOLVER_GUARD=0 disables. */
{ static int en = -1; if (en < 0) { const char* e = getenv("SOLVER_GUARD"); en = e ? atoi(e) : 1; }
/* v80 diag: the input header of the first few GOOD solver runs, to learn
* the layout a corrupt one is compared against. */
fprintf(stderr, "[solver-good] count=%u in@LS 0x%05X:", ctx->gpr[104]._u32[0], ctx->gpr[82]._u32[0] & SPU_LS_MASK);
for (int i = 0; i < 0x50; i += 4) fprintf(stderr, " %02X%02X%02X%02X", q[i], q[i+1], q[i+2], q[i+3]);
if (n++ < 16) fprintf(stderr, "[solver-guard] corrupt item count 0x%X -> 0 (skipping)\n", ctx->gpr[104]._u32[0]);
/* v78 diag: first 3 -> logs/solver_N.bin (LS), _regs.txt (regs + DMA ring),
* _ea.bin (current main-memory contents of every GET source in the ring:
* records of u32 ea, u32 size, bytes). */
if ((f = fopen(fnm, "wb"))) { fwrite(ctx->ls, 1, SPU_LS_SIZE, f); fclose(f); }
fprintf(f, "img=%d pc=0x%05X spu_id=%u count=0x%X\n", ctx->image_id, (unsigned)ctx->pc & SPU_LS_MASK, ctx->spu_id, ctx->gpr[104]._u32[0]);
fprintf(f, "r%d %08X %08X %08X %08X\n", r, ctx->gpr[r]._u32[0], ctx->gpr[r]._u32[1], ctx->gpr[r]._u32[2], ctx->gpr[r]._u32[3]);
uint32_t dn = g_spu_dma_ring_n, k0 = dn > 512 ? dn - 512 : 0;
for (uint32_t k = k0; k < dn; k++) { spu_dma_trace_ent* te = &g_spu_dma_ring[k & 511u];
fprintf(f, "  #%u cmd=%02X lsa=0x%05X ea=0x%08X size=0x%X\n", k, te->cmd & 0xFF, te->lsa, te->ea, te->size); }
uint32_t dn = g_spu_dma_ring_n, k0 = dn > 512 ? dn - 512 : 0;
for (uint32_t k = k0; k < dn; k++) { spu_dma_trace_ent* te = &g_spu_dma_ring[k & 511u];
fwrite(&te->ea, 4, 1, f); fwrite(&sz, 4, 1, f); fwrite(vm_base + te->ea, 1, sz, f); } }
